newsitem.title: FRANCE: German climbing guide seriously hurt on Mont Blanc.
newsitem.headline: German climbing guide seriously hurt on Mont Blanc.

text.p: A German mountain guide was seriously injured in a fall on Mont Blanc in the French Alps on Thursday while leading two other Germans, who were unhurt, police said.

The 31-year-old guide, whose name was not disclosed, was in critical condition in hospital in the Alpine town of Chamonix after falling about 30 metres (100 feet) at an altitude of 3,800 metres (12,350 feet), police said.
June snowfalls and August heat have made for a deadly combination in the Alps this summer, with nearly 100 climbers dead in accidents so far this year.
